name: Export Tycoon
description: You start with a modest treasury and a mandate to conquer the world market. Stand up farms and factories, sell their output abroad, and earn $125M of export revenue inside five years. The world market is deep but not bottomless: every extra unit you export fetches a little less.

goals.description: Earn $125M of export revenue in total within five years — about two well-run export lines. Turn on export for a factory in its inspector.
